question: The software that enables to implement custom application or modify the system for specialized needs is known as ________.
solution:
Correct** Option is 4).**

**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****

__
 
• **Programming software enables** the to implement custom applications or modify the system for specialized needs.
 
• Programming software is also known as a programming tool or software development tool.
 
• Programming software is a program or collection of programs that aid software developers in the creation, debugging, and maintenance of other programs and applications.
 
• Compilers, assemblers, debuggers, interpreters, etc. are examples of programming software.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**** 

__Graphics Software:__

Graphics software** can edit bitmap and/or vector graphics and can be used to design label templates. Examples of graphics software include **Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, CorelDraw, Inkscape, Microsoft Paint, and Paint.Net.**

 

**__Application Software:-__**

The term "application software" refers to software that performs specific functions for a user. **Microsoft Word and Excel, as well as popular web browsers like Firefox and Google Chrome, **are examples of application software.

 

__**Operating Software:-**__

An operating system (OS) is system software that manages computer hardware, software resources, and provides common services for computer programs
